question.text: Under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the mandatory 'continuing interest' requirement for the Sponsor/Manager of a Category II AIF is the LOWER of:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Reg 10(d): Cat I and Cat II continuing interest = lower of 2.5% of corpus OR INR 5 crore. For Cat III, it is lower of 5% or INR 10 crore. Ch 12 references this as the mandatory minimum 'skin-in-the-game'. The Trap: A is the Cat III number. C, D are fabricated. Cross-Exam Context: Also tested in XIX-A (Distributor Cat I/II) and XIX-B (Cat III). In XIX-C, the Manager must know and negotiate ABOVE the minimum. Manager's Pro-Tip: When drafting your PPM, state BOTH percent and INR cap, and show the rupee figure for your actual fund size. LP DD teams appreciate not having to do the math.
